map.A 型破口在升主动脉，易致主动脉破裂或心包填塞，需紧急外科手术；B 型破口在降主: A type has the tear in the ascending aorta and easily causes aortic rupture or pericardial tamponade, requiring emergency surgery. B type has the tear in the descending aorta; if there are no symptoms or complications, blood pressure and heart rate can be controlled with medication, and endovascular repair is only considered when dilation, rupture or organ ischaemia appears. The type is determined by imaging (CT or MRI).
map.DeBakey 分型：I 型起于升主动脉累及主动脉弓及降部，II 型仅限升主动脉: DeBakey classification: type I starts in the ascending aorta and involves the arch and descending aorta, type II is confined to the ascending aorta, and type III starts at the arch-descending junction and extends distally. DeBakey I and II correspond to Stanford A, and III to B.
map.Stanford A 与 B 型处理有何不同？: How does the management of Stanford A differ from B?
map.Stanford 分型判定：破口/夹层累及升主动脉为 A 型（无论起始部位），仅: Stanford classification: a tear or dissection involving the ascending aorta is type A (regardless of where it starts), while one confined to the descending thoracic aorta and beyond is type B. Type A is critical and needs emergency surgery; type B is mostly managed medically (blood pressure and rate control).

map.急诊分诊与预警：突发撕裂样胸背痛、血压差（双臂收缩压差 >20 mmHg）、脉搏: Emergency triage and warning: sudden tearing chest or back pain, a blood pressure difference (systolic difference between arms above 20 mmHg) and an asymmetric pulse suggest a dissection. Combining D-dimer and contrast-enhanced aortic CT allows rapid stratification, and type A should start the emergency pathway immediately.
map.未控制的高血压、马凡综合征等结缔组织病、主动脉瓣二叶畸形、主动脉瘤病史、孕期与医: Uncontrolled hypertension, connective tissue disease such as Marfan syndrome, bicuspid aortic valve, a history of aortic aneurysm, pregnancy and iatrogenic catheter procedures are all high risk. Never delay on sudden severe chest or back pain: call emergency services immediately and lie flat and still.
map.根据夹层累及范围进行Stanford与DeBakey分型，评估治疗策略与风险: Classify by Stanford and DeBakey according to the extent of the dissection, and assess treatment strategy and risk
map.降低左心室收缩速率（dp/dt）与收缩压可减小主动脉壁剪切力，延缓夹层扩展。目标: Lowering the left ventricular contraction rate (dp/dt) and the systolic pressure reduces the shear stress on the aortic wall and delays dissection extension. The usual targets are a systolic pressure of 100–120 mmHg and a heart rate below 60 bpm (for pain, prefer a β-blocker, then add a vasodilator), individualized under monitoring.
map.高血压 JNC 分级与风险分层: JNC Hypertension Classification and Risk Stratification
map.：输入：破口位于升主动脉、累及主动脉弓、伴右臂血压高于左臂 25 mmHg。工具: : Input: the tear is in the ascending aorta, involves the aortic arch, and the right arm blood pressure is 25 mmHg higher than the left. Tool output: Stanford type A (DeBakey I), risk level high, treatment principle emergency surgical replacement / re-stenting, emergency measures controlling systolic pressure to 100–120 mmHg and heart rate below 60 bpm. Tip: for type A the mortality risk rises significantly with every hour of delay, so immediate referral is required.
